description: Returns an innovation record rendered as markdown, including the problem, solution, technical details, and prior art. With include_illustrations it also lists the drawings in its Illustrations section and the drawings it suggests preparing. Illustrations are not a general attachment inventory; omitted attachment metadata or an empty drawings list cannot establish that general attachments are absent. With include_discussions it also lists the comment threads: each with its id, the text it is anchored to and the section, whether it is resolved, and its comments with author and time. A thread whose highlighted text no longer exists has a detached anchor.

include_discussions.description: true to also return the comment threads on the innovation as discussions

include_illustrations.description: true to also return illustrations (numbered as Drawing N in the markdown) and illustrationSuggestions, for example to check what is there before uploading

name: get_innovation

illustrationSuggestions.description: Drawings the innovation suggests preparing, as given in illustrationSuggestions at registration

illustrations.description: The drawings in the invention disclosure's Illustrations section; number matches Drawing N in the markdown

title: Read innovation in Lightbringer
